title: Builld
subtitle: Product studio — fast-track ideas into reality
description: A product studio and web agency that builds custom websites, MVPs, and digital products for startups and businesses. Builld delivers high-quality, branded digital experiences — from landing pages to full web applications — in weeks, not months.
problem: Startups and founders need to move from idea to launch quickly, but hiring a full team or working with large agencies is slow and expensive. They need a studio that can ship polished, production-ready products at startup speed.
role: Founded and built Builld as a product studio — established the development methodology, built the internal tooling and templates, and delivered client projects across web development, UI/UX design, and branding.
approach: Standardized development stack with Next.js/React for rapid prototyping and deployment. Internal templates and component libraries reduce time from concept to live product. Each project gets a tailored approach — from simple landing pages to complex web applications — using a consistent design system and deployment pipeline.
hardestDecision: Balancing speed with quality — the studio model demands fast delivery, but each project needs enough customization to feel unique. Solved this by building a strong internal component library that handles the 80% case, leaving customization budget for the 20% that makes each project distinctive.
outcome: Live at builld.tech. Delivers custom websites and digital products for startups and businesses with consistent quality and fast turnaround.
whatIdChange: Would add an AI-assisted scoping tool for faster project estimation, build a client portal for real-time project tracking, and expand the template library for common startup use cases.
